evidence.detail: Exact v308 NotificationAlertsConfig key notificationSound / title Notification sound returns rs/s/n/c$a and defaults to its NATIVE constant.
Exact v308 enum constants are NATIVE("Native") and OFF("Off"); toString returns the stored display label, and DesktopNotificationService consumes this enum in the notification-sound path.
RuneLite uses the source type name NotificationSound for the notificationSound config setting and the same NATIVE / Off-facing notification-sound domain.

candidates.note: NotificationSound is source-identified by the exact notificationSound config binding, surviving NATIVE/OFF enum surface and RuneLite source identity. SpawnPK's v308 variant contains the two modes NATIVE and OFF; confidence 0.998.
